name: Spica Neal
source:
The innocent-looking girl who sells Kitty Candy in Firefly Alley's central commercial district. However, her Kitty Candy business is just a cover for her hidden business as an informant, trading in risky information. She also sells very rare and expensive Grathnode crystals.

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
